convert_megatron_transformer_checkpoint: convert a Megatron CogView4 transformer checkpoint to Diffusers format using convert_megatron_transformer_checkpoint_to_diffusers
convert_cogview4_vae_checkpoint: convert a CogView4 VAE checkpoint to Diffusers format using convert_cogview4_vae_checkpoint_to_diffusers
run_conversion_script: run the CLI script to convert CogView4 Megatron checkpoints to Diffusers pipeline format with --output_path
swap_scale_shift: swap the scale and shift components in a weight tensor using swap_scale_shift
convert_cogview4_with_control: convert a CogView4 control model checkpoint to Diffusers format by passing the --control flag
